early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated determination (4 of 8 sources, no contradictory declaration; national desk supersedes affiliates; Exchange may replace a source at sole discretion). Kalshi may initiate Market Outcome Review at sole discretion (Rule 6.3(c)). Post-expiration revisions ignored. Party switch between election and swearing-in: resolves on election-day party. No explicit void clause.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'win the Senate race'; rules resolve on party of person sworn in (could differ if winner resigns/vacancy before seating).
